text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My first three years
with Sakura Chiyono O came to an end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "She managed to deliver splendid results in the Twinkle Series."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
Thank you for your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Fufu. I remember, you know.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Handing you that note.
Racing through the Derby together."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Gaining a rival.
...And becoming one myself.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...I've crossed over a mountain.
To a peak that neither Yaeno-san nor Ardan-san
have likely reached yet."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I may have become a new version of myself,
but surely, an end will come for that as well.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps the things I can do from here on
are very few...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She smiles somewhat wistfully.
As if she has prepared herself for what is to come—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: But!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
F-Fufu... We picked the same one.
Well then, um...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: May I go first?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks. Ehehe,
geez, I'm not looking cool at all right now, am I?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Mm, mnh.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
I don't want to give up yet. I don't want to lose yet.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I want to keep running more,
and stack up victory after victory.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"My results might drop off
somewhere down the line, but still...
No matter what... forever...!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Well then,
let's 'leave footprints even when the rain falls'!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Please continue to support Sakura Chiyono O from now on, too!!
